passages.text: The list price of the Tessiva Blood Pressure Monitor (BP-220) is NT$48,000 per unit.
The list price of the IP-300 Infusion Pump is NT$125,000 per unit.
The list price of the US-800 Ultrasound System is NT$1,380,000 per unit; the Tessiva Ultrasound Probe (UP-35) is NT$86,000 each.
This price list applies from October 1, 2026 and replaces the Q3 price list; always quote from the latest quarterly price list.
